sents.j: われわれの先生は真の意味で紳士です。
sents.e: Our teacher is a gentleman in the true sense of the word.

sents.j: 私は真の大人の女性に会いたいと思った。
sents.e: I wanted to meet a really mature woman.

sents.e: The true value of a man does not lie in what he has.

sents.e: He was in the true sense of the word cultured.

sents.e: No matter how rich you are, you can't buy true love.

sents.j: 我々の真の国籍は人類である。
sents.e: Our true nationality is mankind.

sents.j: 彼は世間でいう音楽の真の愛好者だ。
sents.e: He's what society calls a real lover of music.

sents.j: 雪がしきりに降っていた。

sents.j: 彼はしきりに何かをしている。

sents.e: My brother is anxious for fame.

sents.e: She was eager to go home.

sents.e: He is eager to get on in the world.

sents.j: 何も意思がない。
sents.e: I have no real intent.

sents.e: He can make himself understood in English.

sents.e: She grinned her approval.

sents.e: I tried to make myself understood, but in vain.

sents.e: Language is one of the most important ways of communication.

sents.e: My stomach is growling.

sents.e: My stomach aches after meals.

sents.e: There is nothing left in my stomach, either.
